categories.main_business_segments: Precision Tsugami (China) Corporation Limited primarily engages in the professional development, production, and sales of high-end CNC high precision machine tools, including precision lathes, precision machining centres, and precision grinding machines. Its products serve industries such as automobile parts and components, IT electronics including mobile phones and communication facilities, industrial automation, medical instruments, construction machinery, and emerging fields like AI liquid cooling and humanoid robots.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced Japanese CNC high precision machine tool technology from its parent company, Tsugami Japan. It employs precision engineering, high-speed, high-rigidity manufacturing processes, and continuous innovation in machining technology, including intelligent automation with robotic arms and advanced CNC blanking and bending technologies to optimize material usage and production efficiency. The company also implements energy-saving features in its equipment and maintains ISO 14001:2015 environmental management certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include renowned automobile manufacturers, home appliance manufacturers, and smartphone manufacturers worldwide. The products are mainly sold in Mainland China and Taiwan, with exports to Japan, South Korea, Europe, the United States, and Southeast Asia through Tsugami Japan's overseas sales channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, including Zhejiang and Anhui provinces, and Taiwan. It also has a presence in Hong Kong and exports products to Japan, South Korea, Europe, the United States, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Precision Tsugami operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of CNC high precision machine tools. It procures components and parts from suppliers, including its parent company Tsugami Japan, and supplies finished machine tools to downstream customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing product cost-effectiveness, expanding product lines, and moderately increasing production capacity. It prioritizes R&D in precision machine tool manufacturing and low-carbon propulsion systems, aiming to innovate in energy conservation, machining efficiency, and green manufacturing. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent automation to improve product quality and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of CNC high precision machine tools and related after-sales services. The company also earns income from licensing technology and trademarks from its parent company, Tsugami Japan. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods or services to customers, with consideration for variable components such as rights of return.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as the largest foreign-branded CNC machine tool manufacturer in the Chinese market, leveraging its Japanese technology heritage. It competes in high-end CNC machine tools with a focus on precision, speed, and rigidity. Major competitors are not explicitly named, but the company maintains competitive advantages through cost reduction, efficiency improvements, and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 March 2025, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB4.26 billion, representing a 36.6% year-on-year increase, and a net profit of approximately RMB782 million, a 63.0% increase from the previous year. Total assets were about RMB4.25 billion, and net assets were approximately RMB3.13 billion. The company has shown steady growth with improving profitability and operational efficiency over recent years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Precision Tsugami emphasizes high precision, high speed, and high rigidity in its CNC machine tools, delivering cost-effective and technologically advanced products. Its value proposition includes leveraging Japanese technology, providing customized solutions, and maintaining strong customer orientation. The company also focuses on sustainable development, energy efficiency, and environmental responsibility, differentiating itself through innovation and quality assurance.
